intent.text: Adds an optional voucher to account payments (AC1–AC4). Vouchers are recorded with the payment and included in account totals.

how.title: The API records a voucher
how.text: `POST /voucher` validates the amount and records one voucher per payment.

how.title: One Voucher row in the same unit of work
how.text: The voucher row and the payment are saved in the same unit of work, so a failed payment never leaves a voucher behind.

how.title: The form shows the voucher
how.text: The voucher form adds an amount field; the account screen shows vouchers in the total.

invariants.text: A voucher is never more than the account total.

notChanged.text: Refunds and inventory reports are untouched.

notCovered.text: Generated i18n files and form styles.

verify.text: Pay an account with a voucher of 0, a negative voucher and a voucher above the total.

tour.title: The endpoint
tour.text: Start where a voucher enters the system.

tour.title: The schema
tour.text: The migration adds the voucher columns.
